title: Uniformly embeddable polarized objects form a Noetherian subset
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file moduli.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: Prove that a set T of polarized objects admitting representatives (X, L) over fields with Hilbert polynomial P and a closed immersion into P^n_k with O(1) isomorphic to L is Noetherian: |Polarizedstack| is locally Noetherian (locally finite type over Noetherian Spec(Z)), so it suffices to cover T by a quasi-compact subset; the Hilbert scheme H = Hilb^{P,O(1)}_{P^n_Z/Z} is proper over Z (lemma-hilb-proper-over-base) hence Noetherian; its universal closed subspace Z subset P^n_H with N = O(1)|_Z (proper flat fp over H, polynomial P on fibres) classifies to a morphism H -> Polarizedstack (quot-lemma-extend-polarized-to-spaces); continuity of |H| -> |Polarizedstack| makes the image quasi-compact, and assumptions (1) and (2) are exactly the moduli interpretation of H, so T sits inside the image.
